plans.buy_case: EVRG is showing classic mean-reversion setup: RSI 39.5 in oversold zone, price squeezed near lower Bollinger Band, and sitting right on the 200MA with a golden cross above it. plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip into 30-35 range OR price to touch the lower Bollinger Band (≈$82.30). Don't chase at current 39.5—you want confirmation of the reversal, not entry into the final leg down.
